description: Identificar Factores de Riesgos Involucrados en la Siniestralidad Vial de Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Esto con el fin de poder proceder desde la Oficina de Seguridad Vial a comunicar a las partes interesadas respecto a la disponibilidad de la información producto de la Consultoría SDM 2022-1460, cuyo objeto corresponde a “Analizar en Detalle Siniestros Viales con Fatalidades para Identificar Factores de Riesgos Involucrados en la Siniestralidad Vial de Bogotá ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Its tags are accidentes, actor vial, movilidad, siniestros. It offers 4 resource(s) in XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2024-03-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
